I found the bug! In `read_memoryimmediate` at line ~490:

```c
len = tmp;
data[1] = get_varuint32(&code[len], code_len - len, &tmp);
if (len == -1) {  // BUG: should check `tmp == -1`, not `len == -1`
```

The check `if (len == -1)` is wrong - it should be `if (tmp == -1)`. Since `len` was just set to `tmp` (which is a valid positive length), `len == -1` will never be true, so the error check is ineffective. If `get_varuint32` returns -1 in `tmp`, the code will continue with invalid data.
